title: AnalysisApplyOp
description: `analysis.apply` (02 §4.2). System op: record one analysis stage's result and reconcile the document with it (02 §6). The op is order-independent: the document depends on the set of recorded stages, not their arrival order.

stage.description: The stage that finished. Each stage owns at most one effect kind; stages that change no arrangement carry an empty `effects` list (02 §6).

effects.description: The facts the document takes from the blob, in typed form. `bragi-model` cannot read blobs, so the producer projects them here (02 §6, Q12).
